title: Hello

cues.en: Hello, it's me
cues.zh: 哈囉，是我
cues.text: Hello, it's me

cues.en: I was wondering if after all these years you'd like to meet
cues.zh: 我想知道這麼多年後你是否願意見面
cues.text: I was wondering if after all these years you'd like to meet

cues.en: To go over everything
cues.zh: 重溫一切
cues.text: To go over everything

cues.en: They say that time's supposed to heal ya, but I ain't done much healing
cues.zh: 他們說時間應該可以治癒你，但我沒有做太多治療
cues.text: They say that time's supposed to heal ya, but I ain't done much healing

cues.en: Hello, can you hear me?
cues.zh: 你好，能聽見我說話嗎？
cues.text: Hello, can you hear me?

cues.en: I'm in California dreaming about who we used to be
cues.zh: 我在加州夢想著我們曾經是誰
cues.text: I'm in California dreaming about who we used to be

cues.en: When we were younger and free
cues.zh: 當我們年輕自由的時候
cues.text: When we were younger and free

cues.en: I've forgotten how it felt before the world fell at our feet
cues.zh: 我已經忘記了世界在我們腳下之前的感受
cues.text: I've forgotten how it felt before the world fell at our feet

cues.en: There's such a difference between us
cues.zh: 我們之間有這麼大的差別
cues.text: There's such a difference between us

cues.en: And a million miles
cues.zh: 跨越百萬英哩
cues.text: And a million miles

cues.en: Hello from the other side
cues.zh: 來自另一邊的問候
cues.text: Hello from the other side

cues.en: I must've called a thousand times
cues.zh: 我一定打了上千次
cues.text: I must've called a thousand times

cues.en: To tell you I'm sorry for everything that I've done
cues.zh: 告訴你我對我所做的一切感到抱歉
cues.text: To tell you I'm sorry for everything that I've done

cues.en: But when I call, you never seem to be home
cues.zh: 但是當我打電話的時候，你似乎從來都不在家
cues.text: But when I call, you never seem to be home

cues.en: Hello from the outside
cues.zh: 來自外界的您好
cues.text: Hello from the outside

cues.en: At least I can say that I've tried
cues.zh: 至少我能說，我已經盡力嘗試過
cues.text: At least I can say that I've tried

cues.en: To tell you I'm sorry for breaking your heart
cues.zh: 親口對你說聲抱歉，我傷了你的心
cues.text: To tell you I'm sorry for breaking your heart

cues.en: But it don't matter, it clearly doesn't tear you apart anymore
cues.zh: 但沒關係，它顯然不會再把你撕成碎片
cues.text: But it don't matter, it clearly doesn't tear you apart anymore

cues.en: Hello, how are you?
cues.zh: 你好，你好嗎？
cues.text: Hello, how are you?

cues.en: It's so typical of me to talk about myself, I'm sorry
cues.zh: 談論我自己是很典型的，對不起
cues.text: It's so typical of me to talk about myself, I'm sorry

cues.en: I hope that you're well
cues.zh: 希望您一切安好
cues.text: I hope that you're well

cues.en: Did you ever make it out of that town where nothing ever happened?
cues.zh: 你曾經從那個沒有發生任何事情的小鎮出來過嗎？
cues.text: Did you ever make it out of that town where nothing ever happened?

cues.en: It's no secret that the both of us
cues.zh: 眾所周知，我們兩個
cues.text: It's no secret that the both of us

cues.en: Are running out of time
cues.zh: 時間不多了
cues.text: Are running out of time
